reason: My register has never crashed on me, and with UPI the money already shows on my phone. Paying ₹4,999 up front plus ₹999 every month to make my staff do selfies and type numbers on a busy day feels like extra work, not less.
objection: If the app hangs on a Sunday when every chair is full and customers are waiting for their bill, who picks up the phone? With the register nothing stops working.
would_change_my_mind: No setup fee, and a local person I can actually call on Sundays who comes to the salon if it breaks, with my old register entries kept safe as a backup.
